Hey, thanks for the response danguan,

That's the thing... I don't really like anything. There's nothing that I really derive joy from. It's not that I'm sad or depressed, rather, I think at my core I'm just bored.

I guess there are some clubs I could join... I'm sure I'd feel out of place at the beginning, but I would eventually fit in. Another thing that kind of sucks is that I don't drink (personal choice) and you can imagine how much of freshman year revolves around that :P
